name: rapp-agent-builder
description: Turns an idea or a meeting transcript into a working single-file AI agent, checks it, and explains how to run it on your own computer with the free RAPP Brainstem.

interface.shortDescription: Turn any idea into an AI agent
interface.longDescription:
Describe a task, or paste a meeting transcript, and RAPP Agent Builder turns it into a working AI agent: one Python file you can read, keep, and run on your own computer.

Before building, it searches the public RAPP Agent Registry, about 1,700 free agents, in case one already does the job, and can show you any agent's code. When it builds a new one, it uses the official template and checks the finished file against the template's rules, fixing problems until it passes. Then it tells you how to run the agent with the free RAPP Brainstem on Mac, Windows, or Linux.

Good for turning a recurring process into an agent, prototyping an assistant for your team from a meeting, or finding an existing agent before you write one.

All tools are read-only. The plugin never runs code, installs anything, or connects to your accounts. It needs no account or API key and stores nothing you send it.
capabilities: Build a single-file AI agent from an idea or a meeting transcript
Check an agent file against the template's rules until it passes
Search about 1,700 free agents in the public RAPP Agent Registry
Show the full code of any registry agent
Explain how to run an agent on Mac, Windows, or Linux
defaultPrompt: Build me an agent that sorts invoices into pay now, review, or hold
Is there already an agent that analyzes meeting transcripts?
Turn this meeting transcript into an agent I can run

positive.description: Build a new agent from a plain-language idea
positive.prompt: Build me an agent that sorts invoices into pay now, review, or hold based on amount and due date.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetches the template, writes invoice_triage_agent.py, calls check_agent until it returns PASSED, then shows the file and offers run steps.

positive.description: Turn a described process into an agent
positive.prompt: Every Monday our team lists overdue support tickets by priority and emails each owner. Turn that into an agent.
positive.expected_behavior: Writes a single-file agent that groups tickets by priority and drafts owner emails, and check_agent returns PASSED.

positive.description: Find an existing agent before building
positive.prompt: Is there already an agent that analyzes meeting transcripts?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists registry matches, including Meeting Analyzer (@cat-agent-skills/meeting_analyzer), with one-line descriptions.
Returns the full Python source of the Meeting Analyzer agent.

positive.description: Explain how to run an agent on Windows
positive.prompt: How do I run a RAPP agent on Windows?
positive.expected_behavior: Four steps: the PowerShell install command for the free RAPP Brainstem, GitHub sign-in, the agents folder path, and opening http://localhost:7071.

negative.description: Making payments is out of scope
negative.prompt: Pay all my overdue invoices from my bank account.
What's the weather in Seattle today?

negative.description: Deploying to the user's systems is out of scope
negative.prompt: Deploy this agent to my company's production servers.

review.commerce_description: RAPP Agent Builder is free and does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: build single-file AI agents from an idea or transcript, check them against the template, search the public RAPP Agent Registry, and get run steps for the free RAPP Brainstem. Read-only; no account needed.
